vfxPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent animation VFX atlas, EXACTLY 18 separate frames in 6 columns by 3 rows, equal cells with generous gutters and no overlap. Row 1 six sequential frames of a tiny soft warm earth footstep dust puff: first subtle impact, then small rising sandy wisps, expanding airy puff, thinning, fading, final sparse specks. Row 2 six sequential frames of shallow-water footstep splash: tiny jade water crown into low scattered clear droplets and an expanding flat elliptical ripple, fading outward, realistic water. Row 3 six sequential frames of a soft golden harvest reward sparkle: small gleam grows into a few fine warm sparks then disperses and fades, no coins and no objects. Whole atlas true transparent background; no black backdrop, no text, no borders, no checkerboard, no thick clouds, no opaque colored discs. Sharp polished physically rendered miniature farming game effects, fine soft alpha edges. All frames same isometric ground camera, ground contact centered near lower third within each cell, consistent sizes within each row, at least 16 percent empty padding per cell, no elements touching neighboring cells. Prefer subtle readable effects that do not hide feet or crops.
